meta.title: Historical, Religious, Cultural and Natural Places in Pakistan
notes: Timings and ticket info are general guidance only; hours and prices change, so confirm locally before visiting.
Where source_link points to a Wikipedia search page, open it and pick the matching article.
UNESCO status reflects knowledge up to mid-2026; check whc.unesco.org for the latest.
